steps.feet: Put both feet on the floor.

Look around and name

You don't have to figure

exercise.okayHint: Ends this support. After about 20 seconds, asks how you feel.
exercise.closeHint: Ends this support and returns home, or asks how you feel after a short session.
exercise.tryAnotherHint: Chooses another activity here, without ending this support.

blocks.instruction: Place a shape. A full line fades away.
blocks.selectHint: Selects this shape. Then choose a space on the grid, or drag it there.
blocks.placeHint: Selected. Double tap a space on the grid to place it, or double tap again to turn it.

catch.instruction: Tap the circle as it appears.

read.revealHint: Shows the next line. Lines also appear on their own.
read.pausedHint: Lines are paused. Double tap to show the next line.
read.pauseHint: Stops lines from appearing on their own. You can still tap to continue.
read.continueHint: Lets lines appear on their own again.
read.tryAnotherHint: Starts a fresh reading thread here
read.speedHint: How quickly each line appears. Tap anywhere to show the next line immediately.
read.speedBoostOffHint: Shows each line about twice as quickly for this session.
read.speedBoostOnHint: Lines appear about twice as quickly. Double tap to return to normal speed.
read.firstHintTap: Tap anywhere if you want to go faster.

steps.feet: Feel where your feet meet the floor.
steps.weight: Notice the weight of your feet.
steps.support: Feel what is supporting your body.
steps.stay: Stay here for one more moment.

fiveSenses.see: Look around. Name five things you can see.
fiveSenses.touch: Notice four things you can touch.
fiveSenses.hear: Name three sounds you can hear.
fiveSenses.smell: Notice two smells, if any are there.
fiveSenses.taste: Notice one taste, or just the feeling in your mouth.

lookAround.see: Look around and name three things you can see.
lookAround.farthest: Notice the farthest thing you can see from here.
lookAround.still: Look for something that is still.
lookAround.object: Look at one still object near you.

texture.notice: Notice one texture you are not touching.
texture.find: Find something with a little texture.
texture.cool: Find a surface that looks cool to the touch.
texture.temp: Notice a temperature difference, even a small one.

move.noticeFinal: Rest here. Notice how your whole body feels.

hints.press: Press and hold here while you follow the instruction
hints.hold: Keep holding until you are asked to release
hints.notice: Rest here and notice how your body feels

steps.feet: Press your feet gently into the floor.
steps.bodyScan: Scan slowly from head to toe.
steps.hands: Press your hands into your legs.

privacy.onDevice: Everything Back uses for the six tools stays on this device. There is no account and no cloud.
privacy.stored: That can include a support contact you save, Read memory, preferences such as appearance and motion, and a short local list of recent tools.
privacy.notSent: None of this is sent to Back or anyone else. If you call or message, your phone app opens, and it starts only if you confirm.
privacy.emergency: Extra support can help you reach someone nearby. Back does not place the call for you.
privacy.notMedical: Back is not a medical device. It does not create Health Records and it does not read Apple Health.

terms.selfHelp: Back is a self-help tool. It is not therapy and not a medical device.
terms.emergency: Back is not a substitute for emergency care. If you need urgent help, use Extra support or contact local emergency services.
terms.calls: If you call or message someone, your phone app opens. The call or message starts only if you confirm.
terms.data: What you save in Back stays on this device. There is no account and no cloud.

voice.intro: Ground uses on-screen instructions. Listen can play quiet sound on this device.
voice.lastSoundNote: Listen remembers the last sound you choose. That stays on this device.
voice.muteHint: Silences Listen and Ground on this device

about.body: Back is rapid local support for the next minute, with six tools on this device.
about.disclaimer: Back is not a medical device and is not therapy.

subscription.headline: Keep Back close
subscription.headlineExpired: Your Back Plus access has ended.
subscription.introThankYouActive:
Thank you for keeping Back close.

Your subscription helps us care for these tools and keep them private, reliable and available offline.
subscription.intro:
Six simple tools for difficult moments — private, offline and ready whenever you need them.

Try everything free for 7 days with the annual plan when you are eligible. After the trial, an active monthly or annual subscription is required to use Breathe, Distract, Ground, Move, Listen and Read.
subscription.introPreparing:
Back Plus is being prepared.

Back will include a 7-day trial with the annual plan, followed by a monthly or annual subscription. Final prices and renewal details will appear in the App Store or Google Play before purchase.

There is nothing to buy until Back Plus is released.
subscription.introTrialActive: Thank you for trying Back Plus on this device.
subscription.trialAfterNote: After the trial, your plan renews at the price shown in the App Store or Google Play before you confirm.
subscription.introAnnualActive: Your annual Back Plus plan is active on this device. Thank you for supporting Back.
subscription.introMonthlyActive: Your monthly Back Plus plan is active on this device. Thank you for supporting Back.
subscription.introExpired:
Choose a plan to continue using the six Back tools, or restore an earlier purchase.

Emergency information, Extra Support and Call my person are still available.
subscription.safetyBody: Emergency information, Extra Support and Call my person remain available without a subscription. Back is a self-help tool — not an emergency service, medical device or substitute for professional care.
subscription.chooseIntro: Subscriptions are handled by Apple or Google. Prices and trial eligibility come from your store account.
subscription.preparing: There is nothing to buy here yet. When Back Plus launches, you can start a 7-day trial on the annual plan if you are eligible.

subscription.planMonthlyLabel: Renews monthly until cancelled in your store account.
subscription.planAnnualLabel: Renews annually until cancelled in your store account.
subscription.regionalPricing: Prices vary by region and currency. Final prices appear in the store before you confirm purchase.
